intent.raw: Create a strategy using fanout to context-builder using all content created for this proposal, so we can create DomainSpec docs.
intent.objective: Prepare a governed, evidence-scoped fanout route that builds focused context packs from the GoldenQuill promotion governance proposal packet and hands them to DomainSpec spec writing.
intent.operator_sentence: Use Context Builder fanout over the GoldenQuill proposal packet, then write DomainSpec feature docs.

route_menu.context_hint: The safe default is to build context packs and a discovery artifact before DomainSpec mutation. Immediate spec writing is allowed only with an explicit discovery waiver.

items.label: Fanout then discovery
items.description: Build focused context packs, persist a discovery artifact, then invoke DomainSpec spec writing.

items.label: Fanout then waived spec
items.description: Build context packs and pass a skip-discovery waiver to the spec writer.

techniques.purpose: Split the proposal packet into focused context-builder packs before spec writing.
techniques.validation_note: Every pack must map selected evidence to explicit spec-writing obligations.

techniques.purpose: Honor the DomainSpec spec writer discovery precondition before creating feature docs.
techniques.validation_note: Proceed only with persisted discovery or explicit skip-discovery waiver.

techniques.purpose: Prevent external method vocabulary from entering active GoldenQuill implementation-facing docs.
techniques.validation_note: Search the generated docs for blocked vocabulary before completion.

technique_overlays.trigger: The target DomainSpec feature needs concept, architecture, operation, state, event, workflow, mapping, observability, test, and glossary context from separate proposal artifacts.

techniques.validation_note: Each context-builder lane returns a compact pack with obligation coverage.

technique_overlays.validation_expectation: The parent synthesis can trace every required DomainSpec aspect to at least one selected evidence selector.

technique_overlays.trigger: The DomainSpec spec writer requires discovery lookup before authoring or updating feature docs.

techniques.validation_note: Spec writing is blocked unless discovery exists or waiver is explicit.

technique_overlays.validation_expectation: The route records whether discovery was persisted or waived before spec writing.

subagent_strategy.trigger: The context-building step is a fanout across architecture, graph, metrics, decisions, template, and vocabulary evidence.
subagent_strategy.explanation: Role-bound context lanes reduce noise and let the parent synthesis hand the spec writer a compact evidence pack instead of a broad document dump.
context: The proposal packet includes architecture, KPI research, decision-gate output, interrogation records, vocabulary policy, and DomainSpec framework templates.
The DomainSpec spec writer has a discovery precondition and must read the framework changelog before authoring.
Generated docs must preserve GoldenQuill-native vocabulary and the Ontology Vault governance boundary.

roles.purpose: Extract feature boundary, first slice, package shape, and architecture views.
Extract minimum run nodes, edges, pass path, blocked path, and gate traversal rules.
Extract outcome events, lifecycle stages, KPI families, denominator rules, and evidence-state discipline.
Extract resolved decisions, unsafe next steps, and owner-boundary assumptions.
Extract DomainSpec SPEC, architecture, changelog, discovery precondition, and spec-writer obligations.
Extract allowed terms, replacement rules, and acceptance criteria for vocabulary cleanup.

subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: Run the Context Builder fanout lanes and then synthesize a DomainSpec spec-writer handoff?

steps.name: Build focused context packs from the proposal packet

techniques.validation_note: Every lane returns selectors, obligations, blockers, and recommended spec sections.

inputs.ref: user request for DomainSpec spec-writing strategy

stop_conditions: Block if any lane lacks selector-level evidence for its obligation.
Block if proposal context omits the execution DAG node and edge minimums.
Block if DomainSpec template context omits the discovery precondition.

steps.name: Synthesize DomainSpec spec-writer handoff
stop_conditions: Block if obligations are not covered or explicitly deferred.
Block if the handoff fails to name target aspect docs.
Flag if discovery persistence is skipped and no waiver reason is present.

steps.name: Confirm discovery path before spec writing
stop_conditions: Block if no discovery artifact exists and no explicit skip-discovery waiver is approved.

steps.name: Write DomainSpec feature docs from the handoff
stop_conditions: Block if concept IDs are not namespaced as goldenquill-promotion-governance.*.
Block if architecture.md does not include the six DomainSpec views.
Block if spec docs turn KPI observations into promotion authority.

steps.name: Verify generated DomainSpec docs

techniques.validation_note: Search generated implementation-facing docs for blocked vocabulary and flag any drift.

stop_conditions: Block if mandatory nodes or edges are missing from docs.
Block if blocked vocabulary appears in implementation-facing docs.
Block if discovery status is absent from SPEC.md frontmatter when discovery is waived.

gates.condition: Every context-builder lane maps selected evidence to explicit DomainSpec spec-writing obligations.
A discovery artifact exists for the feature, or skip_discovery is approved with a one-line waiver reason.
Generated docs include the minimum grant-run nodes and edges and explain gate traversal.
Evidence packets and KPI observations can create candidates only; owner decisions hold approved allowed uses.
Operator approves moving from proposal-only strategy to DomainSpec doc creation.

boundaries.contract: Import only selector-level evidence mapped to obligations; do not bulk-copy proposal documents.
Handoff must include covered obligations, selected sources, constraints, write scope, done criteria, and blockers.
Spec writing proceeds only after persisted discovery or explicit skip-discovery waiver.
DomainSpec docs may specify behavior but must not mutate runtime data, org memory, signed cards, or Ontology Vault canonical artifacts.

authority.lifecycle: DomainSpec feature docs own specification shape only.
authority.execution: Context Builder owns evidence pack generation; DomainSpec spec writer owns docs generation after approval.
authority.validation: Dispatch validator checks route shape; DomainSpec verification checks generated docs.
authority.evidence: GoldenQuill proposal packet and DomainSpec templates remain source evidence.
authority.memory: No memory promotion occurs in this route.
authority.promotion: Ontology Vault governance layer owns promotion authority; this route only specifies it.

state_namespaces.write_policy: Write only after discovery exists or waiver is approved.
Proposal-only strategy artifacts may be added or revised; do not treat them as runtime mutations.

promotion_splits.rule: Proposal evidence can specify docs but cannot promote runtime memory or Ontology Vault artifacts.
KPIs may create candidates after validation but cannot promote directly.

promotion_guardrails: No automatic promotion from KPI thresholds.
No workspace-safe reuse from org-scoped feedback without redaction/generalization and owner approval.
DomainSpec docs must preserve the execution DAG minimum nodes and edges.
